name: r134a_isenthalpic_throttle
title: Isenthalpic throttle with kinetic energy (R134a)
summary: Outlet state of a refrigerant throttle: the stagnation enthalpy (h + Vel^2/2) is conserved and the mass flow rate is the same in the inlet and in the outlet section of equal area; the model returns the outlet temperature, enthalpy, entropy, specific volume and velocity of an R134a stream expanded from 1000 kPa to 100 kPa.

origin.course: EES for Engineers, Chapter 15 (Diagram Window) example

verification.summary: The R1234yf variant of the same equations reproduces the stored solution of the source EES file: 12 common variables, 8 differ (rtol=0.001), max rel. diff 6.9e-2 on T[2], 4.6e-3 on the enthalpies (EES property tables vs CoolProp HEOS). The shipped R134a file satisfies the energy and mass balances.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/EES_library/Throttle.EES (Diagram-window configuration: R1234yf, P[1] = 1000 kPa, P[2] = 100 kPa, T[1] = 50 °C, Vel[1] = 15 m/s, A = 0.005 m^2)
verification.notes: compare_solution.py (rtol=0.001): 12 common variables, 8 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 1 (the unused scalar m_dot of the original); only in CoolSolve: 4 (P[2], s[1], s[2] and the fluid string). Deviations: EES R1234yf property tables vs CoolProp HEOS (h[1] 4.4e-3), amplified into the outlet temperature (T[2] 21.1958 vs 19.7436 °C) at the low outlet pressure of 100 kPa. The .sol baselines were produced with the CoolProp revision 8eb3b778 of the build used here (the library baselines were produced with 75af7816).

history.action: added (card C-517, T-IMPORT of EEL-115 Throttle.EES; R1234yf variant ships the configuration of the stored EES solution)
